items.title: KEET PBS North Coast and The League of Women Voters of Humboldt County 2018 Candidate Forum: Eureka City Council Ward 1
items.description:
PBS North Coast and the League of Women Voters of Humboldt County
present a forum for candidates running to represent the First Ward on
the Eureka City Council. The candidates are Caroline Brooks, Leslie
Castellano, Hailey Lamb, and Anthony Mantova.

items.title: 2009 commercial for Eureka Skydeck (2)
items.description:
A commercial from Melbourne, Australia for an ugly skyscraper. I assure you Melbourne has plenty of buildings much nicer than this. 

Note: taped off air during April 2009, so I list it as being from that year, but it's possible it first aired during 2008.
